name: UGC 5427 (Hubble)
blurb: UGC 5427, a galaxy in the Lynx-Cancer void, seen by Hubble.
label: ugc05427-hubble
story: UGC 5427 lies in the Lynx-Cancer void. Hubble resolved its stars to gauge its distance, one piece of a three-dimensional map of the nearby universe.

claims.text: UGC 5427 (MCG 5-24-10), type SABd, is in the Lynx-Cancer void sample
The program measured distances to nearby galaxies from the luminosities of red giant branch stars, to build 3D maps of galaxies
